Create table BASE_ATRASO as select
B.*,
C.dtvencimento,
intck('day', datepart(B.dtpagamento), datepart(C.dtvencimento))
FROM
connection to perm
(
SELECT
C.nucontratogestao,
C.sqcontratofinanceiro,
C.cdnossonumero,
C.dtvencimento,
C.cdparcela
FROM bv-pdbd-prd.trusted_dbcontencioso.tbnegociacaoparcela C
) AS C
LEFT JOIN WORK.BASE_PAGAMENTOS B ON C.NuContratoGestao = B.nucontratogestao AND C.sqcontratofinanceiro = B.sqcontratofinanceiro AND C.cdnossonumero = B.cdnossonumero
WHERE B.dtpagamento IS NOT NULL
AND B.NuContratoGestao = '13321000000056'
AND B.sqcontratofinanceiro = 1
AND B.cdnossonumero = '60893'
;disconnect from perm;
quit;
